checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: The p1000 picks up a fresh tip for each of the 48 tubes and dispenses into 48 distinct odd-column wells. Checks 48_samples_to_odd_columns, fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact and distinct_elution_wells all passed.

Beads (40 uL), isopropanol (250 uL) and sample (250 uL) are added in that order, followed by mix(5), a 5 min delay, magnet engage with a 4 min delay, and 540 uL removed with the magnet on. Checks binding_volumes_40_250_250, mix_5x_after_sample, incubation_5min_before_magnet and magnet_4min_before_first_removal passed.

Two 500 uL ethanol washes are each removed with the magnet engaged, then a 4 min delay and magdeck.disengage() before elution. Checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes, magnet_engaged_for_all_removals and air_dry_4min passed.

The agent recovers the full ELUTION_VOL of 100 uL (m300.aspirate(ELUTION_VOL,...)) instead of about 80 uL, which would draw up beads. The other elution steps are correct: 100 uL added off-magnet with a 10x mix, a 90 s magnet delay, 4 C plate, distinct wells.

Step order and reagent identities match the paper, with 70% ethanol, isopropanol, elution buffer and a 4 C elution plate. The comments match what the code does, and the added bead pre-mix is not a reordering.

judge.summary: The protocol passes all 16 run-log checks and correctly implements sample handling, binding and separation, and the washes with drying. It fails elution_recovery because it recovers 100 uL rather than about 80 uL, which risks carrying over beads.
